function.name: ProductSearch_execute
function.description: Performs a search for products in the database based on specified criteria, such as keywords and filters, and returns a list of matching products. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

keywords.description: The search terms used to find products, separated by spaces.

category.description: The category to filter the search results. If no category is specified, all categories will be included in the search.

price_range.description: A price range to narrow down the search results, specified as a string in the format 'min-max' where min and max are prices in USD.

sort_order.description: The order in which the search results are sorted. Choose 'asc' for ascending or 'desc' for descending order.

in_stock.description: A flag to filter search results to only include products that are in stock. Set to true to include only in-stock items.

message.content: Hai! Untuk membantu memeriksa ketersediaan warna pink, bisakah Anda memberi tahu nama produk atau ID-nya? Dengan begitu, saya bisa mencari informasi restock yang lebih akurat. Terima kasih!
message.reasoning:
The user says: "Warna pink kapan restok kak". This is Indonesian: "When will the pink color restock?" They want to know when the pink color product will restock. We need to respond appropriately. We can ask clarifying question: which product? Or we can provide general info: we don't have real-time inventory. We can say we can't check real-time but we can search for product with keyword "pink" maybe. But the user didn't specify product name. We could ask them to specify product. Or we can search for "pink" in all categories. But that might return many results. We should ask clarifying question: what product? So we ask: "Could you tell me the product name or ID?" That would be best.

We should respond politely.
